evidence.correlation: Stock userspace requests a 16 MiB shared bypass mapping and uses the C2H read path. Its separate dma_auklet interface requests 256 MiB with destination at plus 128 MiB and two distinct ioctls. No supplied module or pinned public implementation establishes that provider; no equivalence to XDMA is claimed.
evidence.limits: Static software plumbing does not determine FPGA reset values, register side effects, ready/completion timing, interrupts, sample framing or acquisition data. BAR roles, engine capabilities and alignment are runtime inputs. No module was loaded, guest run started, stock artifact changed, or physical instrument accessed.
